Messages.Author: Murphy Christopher J
Messages.Body:
player 1: Strike: Body of Sun / Burst of Sunlight / etc. (both vamps dmged)
player 2: Strike: Whatever -- not dodge though.

Strk Res...
player 1: No prevent dmg cards
player 2: Prevents all dmg from strike

Result: Player 1 is damaged according to the card.
Player 2 is not damaged by that strike.

P.S. It's really pretty obvious if you read the rulebook (Although the
'book is bloody ambiguous in certain instances. For example:
One would think that the Thaumaturgy skill is a scholarly thing involving
complex rituals, memorizing sorcerous chants, etc. But what about this:
Player 1: plays Drawing out the Beast (allowing the opponent to only
perform hand strikes, right?)
Player 2: plays a Thaumaturgy strike card (say: Blood Fury)
Can this be done ^ ? )

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
3cj...@qlink.queensu.ca (Murphy Christopher J) writes:
>Player 1: plays Drawing out the Beast (allowing the opponent to only
>perform hand strikes, right?)

No, dissallowing weapons is not the same as allowing only hand strikes.

>Player 2: plays a Thaumaturgy strike card (say: Blood Fury)
> Can this be done ^ ? )

Sure.
